# A valid note (G12) followed by one byte 00.

type note
breaks 5.4, point 10
expect TrailingBytes -
offset 44
extent 1
requests test.note.title:6 test.note.what.target:4 test.note.owner:4 test.note.body:5
input 00000006 72656164 6d650000 00000001 00000004 646f6373 00000004 726f6f74 00000005 01020304 05000000 00
